title: X–XII. Concrete/abstract; first name Jehovah / Tetragrammaton
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): XI. Seventh, some concrete are, as God, Lord, Father: some abstract, as life, charity, deity. Those teach that God truly subsists: but these that a most simple being He is. XII. And this ye distinction belonging toward ye divine names is. FIRST is YHWH (Exodus 15:3; Psalm 83:19; Isaiah everywhere). This name also ye Tetragrammaton plus Schemhamphoras is called. Letters, as quantities, whether painted or pronounced, of themselves no efficacy have. Ye name YHWH or Tetragrammaton or Schemhamphoras neither miraculous nor magical force has.
pass_b_english: XI. Seventh, some are concrete, as God, Lord, Father: some abstract, as life, charity, deity. Those teach that God truly subsists: but these that He is a most simple being. XII. And this is the distinction of the divine names.

FIRST is YHWH (Exodus 15:3; Psalm 83:19; Isaiah everywhere). This name is also called the Tetragrammaton and Schemhamphoras. Letters, as quantities, whether painted or pronounced, of themselves have no efficacy. The name YHWH or Tetragrammaton or Schemhamphoras has neither miraculous nor magical force.
source_text: XI. Septimo, quaedam sunt concreta, ut Deus, Dominus, Pater: quaedam abstracta, ut vita, charitas, deitas. Illa docent, Deum esse vere subsistentem: haec vero eum esse ens simplicissimum. XII. Atque haec est nominum divinorum distinctio. PRIMUM est יהוה. Exod. 15.3; Psal. 83.19; Esai. passim. Hoc nomen Tetragrammaton & Schemhamphoras etiam dicitur. Literae, utpote quantitates, sive pictae sive pronunciatae, per se nullius sunt efficaciae. Nomen MT' sive Tetragrammaton sive Schemhamphoras nec miraculosum nec magicam vim habet.
